title: When do explicit penalties improve flow matching?
abstract: arXiv:2610.15689v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Flow matching can learn structure directly from data, raising the question of when additional constraints improve generation. We study penalties that encode such constraints, with physics-informed flow matching as a motivating example. Satisfying a constraint more closely need not make the generated distribution more accurate. We therefore compare penalised and unpenalised generative modelling through their expected squared $2$-Wasserstein error. Our analysis covers both vector-valued and functional data in a Hilbert-space setting. We first derive geometric criteria that account for constraint violations and the distribution of samples after projection onto the constraint set. We then solve the statistical comparison explicitly for specific velocity-field classes and constraints via flow matching. translated_title: 显式惩罚何时能改进流匹配？
translated_abstract: 流匹配可以直接从数据中学习结构，这引出了一个重要问题：额外的约束何时能改进生成效果。我们研究了编码此类约束的惩罚项，并以物理信息流匹配作为动机示例。更紧密地满足约束并不一定使生成的分布更准确。因此，我们通过期望平方 2-Wasserstein 误差来比较带惩罚与不带惩罚的生成建模。我们的分析涵盖了希尔伯特空间设置中的向量值数据和函数型数据。我们首先推导出同时考虑约束违反程度以及样本投影到约束集后分布的几何准则。然后，我们针对特定的速度场类别和约束，通过流匹配显式求解了这一统计比较问题。在该模型中，恰好当估计方差的减少超过平方偏差的增加时，惩罚才能提高生成精度。
tldr: 该论文以期望平方 2-Wasserstein 误差为度量，在希尔伯特空间框架下推导出几何准则并显式求解统计比较，证明了流匹配中的显式惩罚（如物理约束）恰好在其带来的方差减少超过平方偏差增加时才能提升生成精度。
